scope: Advanced reader page modes, geometry and typography controls, focus/full-screen controls and device-local preference migration
features: Single, facing and continuous PDF modes with bounded nearby surfaces
Single/two-column/scrolled EPUB with section-boundary wheel navigation
PDF fit width/page/actual, zoom, rotation, cover pairing, page direction and inversion
EPUB typeface, size, alignment, measure and spacing
Direct page/section jump, focus mode and full screen
Preserved original-based locators, highlights and local preferences

corpus.scope: Existing hash-pinned real-book corpus and generated 240-page stress test, at mobile-sized viewports; baseline single-page workflow, with advanced mode coverage supplied by generated browser and native tests

accessibility.scope: Populated chrome at 1280px and 390px including expanded typography controls and focus mode; keyboard/focus and dark/accent checks. Imported book subtree excluded.

repairs: Mode rebuilds commit after painting, leaving the prior content and locator intact on error
Canceled fetched pages and distant continuous surfaces release resources
Background neighbor errors do not repeatedly retry
Delayed resize work preserves pending page navigation
Full-screen custom dropdowns mount inside the full-screen subtree
Mobile settings disclosure has an explicit accessible name; focus shortcut uses full-contrast text; focus return is explicit
harnessChanges: Legacy combined font/PDF zoom controls replaced by format-specific controls; corpus PDF value 36 changed to 200 percent to retain its 2x zoom workload
Bitmap-cap test checks doubled display width while preserving pixel bounds; offset-rounding test derives canonical points from rendered scale
EPUB wheel test proves real wheel movement then uses the paginator public anchor method to position at the boundary; oversized synthetic wheel deltas were coalesced differently by Firefox

The independent-import sync test now shares one generated Blob across devices. Regenerating a ZIP across a timestamp boundary produced different originals and invalidated the identical-content premise; production sync code is unchanged
Native WebDriver smoke waits for visible controls, settled finite animations and the loaded Read action; earlier harness quoting/readiness errors were corrected before the final fresh-profile pass

passed: PDF facing spread and cover-aware next navigation
Continuous PDF cache budget and saved page after close/reopen
PDF fit, rotation, zoom, theme and focus controls
EPUB facing/continuous flow, typography and section resume
native.scope: Extracted development .deb on Linux Wry 0.57.1 with system WebKitWebDriver; isolated XDG directories, generated PDF and EPUB, no user library changes

environment.measurements: Shared host; desktop compilation finished before corpus. Native smoke could overlap corpus; timings are observations, not isolated performance benchmarks.

limits: Fixed-layout EPUBs retain publisher spread rules and do not support text reflow or continuous mode
Continuous EPUB flow loads one section at a time; touch users can use Next/Previous at boundaries

PDF continuous steady display retains at most six surfaces/8M raster pixels; detached in-flight canvases, placeholders, worker/source/font/GPU allocations and sidebar thumbnails are not a total-memory cap
Corpus decode-limited pages remain known visible failures; broader conformance, physical mobile hardware and assistive-technology sessions are not certified
Existing desktop experimental status and native authentication/signing limits remain
